TrayOpen — 36 frames at 60 fps, TrayRoot forward 130 mm, ease in and out. Forwards opens, backwards closes. With the power off the drawer stays shut, as it does on the machine.

Modelled from

Every panel is measured off the FZ-1 service manual's own elevations, scaled against the published 284 × 268 × 88 mm and checked against photographs. Four fluted corner columns carry the case and the machine stands on them. POWER is let into the far-left column, OPEN/CLOSE into the far-right one, at the same height; the 136 × 26 mm tray door sits dead centre with READY to its left and ACCESS to its right, and the CONTROLLER port (D-sub 9) low and 35 mm right of centre.

Rear, left to right as you stand behind it: EXPANSION, CH SELECT, RF OUT, S-VIDEO OUT, VIDEO OUT, AUDIO OUT R and L, then the power cord. CH SELECT is on the back — putting it on the front was this model's first mistake. READY is a red lamp, CD ACCESS a green one, and AV EXPANSION is a cover low on the right flank.

Flat PBR colours still, with no UV unwrap or baked maps.
